title: Fantasy Football Garden Flag Last Place Punishment
description:
Quick overview
This bold 12 x 18 inch garden flag is designed as a good-natured last-place punishment for adult fantasy-football leagues. It’s made to be shown off (or laughed at) at draft parties, watch parties, the office, or the loser’s home. The printed joke on the flag is fixed exactly as shown below — no changes.

Printed wording on the flag
Eyebrow: LAST PLACE CERTIFIED
I SUCK AT
FANTASY
FOOTBALL
Footer: ASK ANYONE IN MY LEAGUE

Verified product facts
- Size: 12 x 18 inches
- Same design printed on both sides (mirrored/same art) so the joke shows from either side
- Material: weather-resistant polyester for outdoor display
- Top pole sleeve for standard garden-flag poles and stands
- Printed to order by a trusted print-on-demand production partner
- Garden-flag stand is not included

Use & occasions
Perfect for draft day, end-of-season toilet-bowl ceremonies, league parties, or as a gag gift to make the league loser wear their confession with pride. Bold, readable type and high-contrast colors ensure it’s visible across the room or yard.

Production notes & disclosure
This listing and layout were created with AI-assisted copy/layout help. The physical product is produced on demand by a print-on-demand production partner and printed to order. All verified product facts above are accurate.

Store intent
This is our direct flagship confession flag — the core joke is used across formats in our shop without changing the printed phrase. If you’d like matching items or alternate formats (shirts, signs, smaller flags) check our shop listings.
